text: The Anti-Breakthrough (Micro-Dosing): A brain stuck in alarm can often take in healing work for only a few seconds at a time, Perry finds. So for now we have to give up on the hour-long breakthrough that therapy aims for, since an hour spent working on the trauma itself overwhelms an armored nervous system more than it heals it. Instead, this protocol works in doses of a few seconds, which is what I mean by micro-dosing here.
section: Psychology is the Software; Biology is the Hardware., the Anti-Breakthrough
reader: an adult with trauma who has done years of therapy and still gets triggered, reading why the protocol starts with the body, used to hour-long therapy sessions
